chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام:
Concerning a young boy who chooses shirk while he is between his two parents, he عليه السلام said:
"He is not to be left alone; and that is when one of his parents is a Christian."

key_terms.لَا يُتْرَكُ: he is not to be left alone or allowed to remain so

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a child who chooses shirk while living with his parents?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a minor who adopts shirk while living with his parents. The ruling states that he is not to be left to that choice in a case where one of his parents is Christian, indicating legal consideration of parental religious environment in the child's status.
